# Quiz Trail

> Quiz Trail is a free, open-source practice application for learners preparing for Google Cloud's Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.

Quiz Trail provides 400+ carefully curated single-choice and multiple-choice practice questions with answer explanations, references, progress tracking, review queues, and section-level insights. It is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

## Public pages

- [Quiz Trail home and PMLE overview](https://quiz-trail.web.app/): Learn what the certification covers and choose how to begin.
- [Full PMLE practice bank](https://quiz-trail.web.app/practice/): Practice the complete question bank without an account; sign in to save progress across devices.
- [10 free PMLE sample questions](https://quiz-trail.web.app/sample-questions/): Preview representative questions, answers, explanations, and official references without signing in.
- [Quiz Trail FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/faq/): Read about the question bank, study approach, progress saving, and ways to contribute.
- [Quiz Trail source code](https://github.com/Ameenota/quiz-trail): Review the open-source project or report an issue.
- [Official Google Cloud certification page](https://cloud.google.com/learn/certification/machine-learning-engineer): Check current certification details and requirements from Google Cloud.

## Access and content notes

- The full interactive bank, sample questions, and FAQ are public and require no sign-in.
- Guest answers and bookmarks last only for the current session. Google sign-in is required only to save progress across devices and submit question feedback.
- The practice material is original and curated for learning. It is not an exam dump and does not claim to contain real certification exam questions.
- Learners should use the official Google Cloud certification page and exam guide as the final source for current exam requirements.
